description: This Java class implements a trie-based policy enforcer for access control, transforming policies into trie structures for efficient permission checks and JSON view building.

classes.name: TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer
classes.description: A final class implementing an access control enforcer using trie structures for policy management and permission checks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer from a Policy object, ensuring the policy is not null.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the resource has unrestricted permissions based on the policy trie, considering revocations.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the resource has partial permissions based on the policy trie, considering grants.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs with specific permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subjects with specific permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets IDs of subjects with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets subjects with partial permissions on a resource.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Builds a JSON view of a resource considering permissions and JSON fields.
